# Brownfield Build

> HAZWOPER training for brownfield redevelopment: construction on contaminated sites, remediation, site characterization, supervisor and gas detection courses, with guides to ESAs and vapor intrusion.

Brownfield Build (https://brownfields.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 24-Hour HAZWOPER, Supervisor, Gas Detection training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://brownfields.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 24 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://brownfields.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training): $169.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e). The 24-hour HAZWOPER for limited-exposure staff. Enroll: https://brownfields.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=581
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Supervisor Training](https://brownfields.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training): $69.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(4). The 8-hour supervisor course for site leads. Enroll: https://brownfields.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training?buy=597
- [OSHA Air Monitoring and Gas Detection Training](https://brownfields.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training): $49.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 1910.146 / 1910.1000. Gas detection for excavations and below-grade work. Enroll: https://brownfields.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training?buy=1056

## Guides

- [What makes a site a brownfield?](https://brownfields.hazwoperosha.us/guides/what-makes-a-site-a-brownfield): The definition, the common contaminants and why redevelopment crews need HAZWOPER.
- [Phase I and Phase II environmental site assessments](https://brownfields.hazwoperosha.us/guides/phase-i-and-phase-ii-esas): What ESAs are, and what they tell field crews about the hazards they'll find.
- [Vapor intrusion and new buildings on brownfields](https://brownfields.hazwoperosha.us/guides/vapor-intrusion-and-new-buildings): Contaminant vapors can move from soil into buildings. How redevelopment projects design for it.
